decision_notes: Own assembly website designates its recording provider. Plenary 13 October 2026 with Renato Antunes speaking at the lectern, and committee public hearing 23 September 2026 on regulation of behaviour analysis for people with ASD, João Paulo Costa speaking. Inset interpreters visible; hearing is distinct from plenary. Two selected recordings decode and advance in Chromium and WebKit; captured Chromium frames were visually reviewed, with additional WebKit visual review for the new Ceará and Paraíba samples. Muted samples do not certify audible quality, current live or complete room coverage.

Official institutional viewing link only. No independent blanket audiovisual reuse grant was established from the reviewed source navigation. Personal-use permission remains pending; no provider embed, extracted media, rehosting or IPTV export is added. Reviewed Alepe terms address lawful use, intellectual-property responsibilities and personal-data protection; no blanket session-video licence or prior ordinary-link consent condition was identified.
